steps: Take a free online course on organization and time management (e.g., Coursera's 'Work Smarter, Not Harder').
Volunteer at a local clinic or hospital to build relationship-building and teamwork skills.
Enroll in a medical terminology or healthcare communication course to strengthen communication and client-navigation skills.
Shadow a nurse or medical assistant to learn appointment-scheduling and community-based interventions.
Pursue a certification or associate degree in nursing or medical assisting to formalize your skills.
